name: Fisher Geordie

intro.text: I fish for salmon off the Tyne. They came back when the river was cleaned up. First one in a hundred years: I cried. Right here, on this quay.

win: Canny work, pet. You've a fine hand.
after: The Tyne was once nearly dead from the shipyards. Now it has salmon and seals. That's a good bit of cleaning.
